messages:
devon: Heads-up — the structured-output eval runner started failing on the Llama-3-quant onboarding run. CI shows a jsonschema validation error and the func_call correctness metric dropped to 0.69 on the quantized build :eyes:

maria: Ugh, saw the alerts. Is this the new runner v2? Any stack or sample payload?

devon: Runner v2. Quick paste of the failing log:```
ERROR jsonschema.ValidationError: Additional properties are not allowed ('tool_response' was unexpected) at /response/0
  response: {
    "name": "get_price",
    "arguments": {"symbol": "AAPL"},
    "tool_response": {"price_cents": 17423}
  }
```

sam: Looks like our expected schema doesn't include `tool_response`. We intentionally moved raw tool outputs under `meta.tool_output` in the new schema. Why did runner still emit top-level `tool_response`? :thinking_face:

maria: That suggests a mismatch between the schema version the runner uses and the eval spec the CI checks. CI wiring might be pointing at the old schema file. ci-bot, can you paste the policy used for this job?

ci-bot: CI job: eng-ml/structured-evals/llama-3-quant (run #482)
Spec URI: s3://redwood-evals/specs/struct-output-v1.json
Runner config: repo:/eval-runner@refs/heads/main
Schema used by test: struct-output-v1.json

eva: I pushed schema v2 yesterday (struct-output-v2.json) that allows `meta.tool_output` and marks `tool_response` as deprecated. The eval runner image didn't pick up the latest artifact due to the cache TTL on the artifact resolver.

liam: That TTL bug is the same one that caused the metric-definition PR to see stale thresholds last week. We should either invalidate cache on deploy or embed schema version in the Docker image.

devon: For immediate remediation can we update the CI job to accept either shape? Temp fix: relax the jsonschema with `additionalProperties: true` for `response` items so the quant onboarding run can finish while we patch the runner. Thoughts?

maria: I'd rather add a minimal schema OR rule that accepts `tool_response` and maps it into `meta.tool_output` during validation step so we don't swallow unexpected fields silently. Also update the metric computation to prefer normalized fields.

sam: Agree. Quick shim in the CI validator that does: if response has `tool_response` then move into `meta.tool_output` before validation. I'll open a tiny PR.

devon: Also let's log a metric-level delta: record how many examples had the old `tool_response` shape. We need that for the reporting dashboard and to quantify how widespread the issue is.

eva: On quantization: note that the func_call metric drop to 0.69 was only on int4 builds. Float16 on the same model is 0.94. Could be a decoding edge-case in the quantized runtime that serializes tool calls slightly differently (extra whitespace or ordering).

liam: Good call. I can add a comparator that canonicalizes JSON arguments (sort keys, strip whitespace) before computing func_call exact-match. That will make the metric more robust to serialization differences. But we should not mask real regressions.

maria: For the dashboard: add two series — raw func_call match and canonicalized func_call match. That will let product/ops see if it was a serialization flake or an actual correctness regression.

devon: Sam's PR to add the validation shim: https://github.com/redwood/eval-runner/pull/254 (WIP). CI currently failing because the lint step flags my local debug prints.

sam: Pushed a new commit that only runs the shim in CI (feature-flagged). CI rerun: https://ci.redwood.internal/482/ (green on schema-check now).

ci-bot: CI status: structured-evals/llama-3-quant #482 — schema-check: passed, unit-tests: failed, metrics-step: passed, report-upload: pending

devon: Unit test failure is a flaky seed in the evaluation harness (timing-dependent). I'm re-running the job with deterministic RNG seed.

maria: Postmortem action items from this thread: 1) runner should bundle schema or pin spec URI per release, 2) CI validator should be able to auto-migrate deprecated fields, 3) add canonicalization comparator for func_call metric, 4) surface both raw and normalized metrics in the dashboard, 5) fix artifact resolver cache TTL. I'll create a ticket with owners.

liam: Assign me for #3 and #4. Devon take #2. Eva take #5. Sam follow-up on the PR and add a changelog note.

devon: Thanks. I'll also add a small integration test that simulates `tool_response`->`meta.tool_output` migration and assert metric parity between shapes.

sam: PR merged to feature branch, leaving the relax-shim in place until next canary deploy. :ok_hand:

maria: Great. If CI is green after the deterministic rerun, I'll let the onboarding run continue and watch the dashboard.

ci-bot: CI rerun: job #483 — all checks passed. Report pushed to: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/evals/llama-3-quant/483

devon: Dashboard shows canonicalized func_call = 0.93, raw = 0.70. Looks like quantization serialization quirks, not model hallucinations. Filing follow-ups to improve the runtime's JSON emitter. :bug:
